name: City of Batavia utility billing

observed_public.identity: Batavia Illinois city utility billing; catalog water-sewer record only. City billing may combine services; no other Batavia records are mapped.

city_direct_draft.execution: monthly utility balance on due date
city_direct_draft.enrollment: Call utility billing or return authorization form in person, drop box, or regular mail; do not email sensitive form data.

paymentus_autopay.fees: Fees apply; current numeric fees not established by a live quote
paymentus_autopay.duplicate_warning: Do not enroll again in Paymentus if enrolled in city Auto Pay; current page warns of duplicate payments.

documented_guide_behavior.evidence_scope: Currently linked official six-page guide, with December 2020 sample; documented layout, not current live portal observation

fields: Service Address Street Number (everything before the first space)
stages: Review billing address/name, choose email/SMS notification, accept Payment Authorization Terms
link_account.paperless_default: No as shown; Yes disables paper mail

documented_guide_behavior.recovery: Enter email; follow instructions emailed. Link versus temporary password, expiry, and private continuation unknown.
documented_guide_behavior.posting: Guide says next business-day credit and up to 48 hours for website balance/paperless changes; no precise current cutoff/calendar.

notification_preferences.controls: Edit Notification Email and Mobile under More; paperless can be switched back to paper bills

wallet.capability: View or change methods of payment

source_conflicts_and_limits: FAQ describes a December 14, 2020 upgrade, not a new 2026 rollout.
Guide uses old cityofbatavia.net links and a December 2020 example. Its fee/limit values must not be silently treated as current checkout policy.
Current billing page distinguishes free city draft from fee-bearing processor AutoPay; these are separate enrollment states.
Historical FAQ states 18-month history and limited channel visibility; no current live verification.
PDF membership/fee policies from Charlotte County or other Paymentus tenants do not apply automatically.
Google Pay/payment wallets do not imply Sign in with Google.
The 141 child sources collected from city pages belong to the Apptegy city frontend, not the inaccessible Paymentus authenticated SPA. They do not establish billing portal source completeness.
